directive.quote: Target: generic coverage command for any source/piece list which fails/returns exact gaps when a source piece has neither a linked operable step nor valid recorded no_check reason, with correct provenance/identity, no silently accepted empty reason or dangling source/step.

job: validate exact source and piece byte pins and explicit step anatomy before counting linked instruction coverage
banned_substitutions: reimplementing sweepAtoms instead of importing its existing public owner
calling supplied-inventory structural coverage proof of whole-source extraction, semantic correctness or execution
inventing a deletion date or claiming a source-first byte-copy baseline for the new strict qualification wrapper

distinct_from.why: Current origin/main imports the already ported public sweepAtoms for method-source change detection. Its record() also refuses changed/new method atoms when a citing check.source.identity differs from the current atom; that existing pin invariant is acknowledged, not claimed new. record() reads the method filesystem and mutates methods/sources.json. It does not perform this new pure caller-supplied whole-inventory qualification: canonical explicit-step anatomy, all current source/piece/step links (not only changed method atoms), exact supplied piece text, and pinned no_check reasons before the reused shared sweep. No legacy sweep or record() implementation is copied here.

Existing piece-sweep owner provides sweepAtoms and bounded account coverage based on check-row existence or nonblank reasons. This new wrapper imports sweepAtoms unchanged after validating source/piece exact-byte pins, full step anatomy, all cited piece versions and source-pinned reasons. It does not replace account coverage or add a second piece sweep.

Shared validator owns recipe/step anatomy and machine-check shapes. The wrapper calls it; its new job is cross-row exact-byte provenance qualification before inventory coverage, not another anatomy validator.
Shared identity owner calculates exact byte BLAKE3. The wrapper imports it and compares identities across supplied source, piece and instruction rows; it introduces no hash implementation.

Its sourceCoverage identifier binds an OR behavior observation to an expected source test, using or-source-test-coverage.json. It does not inspect retained source pieces, source byte pins, canonical step anatomy or step derivation provenance.

phrasings: validate exact source and piece byte pins and explicit step anatomy before counting linked instruction coverage
qualify source pieces before shared sweepAtoms coverage
